data.title: 空门苍 · 后山树荫下的肩膀借宿
data.description: 漫步在前往灯塔的林荫小道上，走着走着苍的步调就慢了下来。她自然而然地靠上身旁人的肩膀，微热的脸颊贴着衣料，任由海风撩起校服的领结。
data.location: narrow cobblestone island path through lush coastal forest toward lighthouse
data.action: 她自然而然地靠上身旁人的肩膀，微热的脸颊贴着衣料，任由海风撩起校服的领结
data.lighting: soft sea breeze rustling green leaves casting moving shadows over school sweater vest
data.promptProse: Ao's sky-blue hair and red clip rest against the sleeve of a boy walking next to her on the tree-lined island path. He has short chestnut hair, a stone-blue overshirt and straight dark trousers. Her sailor collar and tie sway as they walk slowly through dappled sunlight.
